//Api: PathBase is the API Gateway stage name, which doubles as a URL path prefix. Applied only when running under Lambda. It was a compiled-in constant, which meant a second stage 404'd every route. Set Api__PathBase per environment.
//Cors: Localhost origins belong in appsettings.Development.json only. This list is credentialed (AllowCredentials), so a localhost entry here makes anything on that port a trusted origin in production.
//Payments: Fees owed to Housing Hub only, never custody of anyone else's money — holding a renter's rent is escrow and needs a CBN licence we do not have. Enabled is false until prices are agreed: while it is false, verification submission does not ask for payment and every existing flow is unchanged. Prices are WHOLE NUMBERS OF KOBO, so 500000 is five thousand naira; a missing or non-positive price makes the endpoint refuse rather than give the item away free. SecretKey is both the API credential and the webhook signing key — set it via Payments__Paystack__SecretKey and never commit it.
//Secrets: Secrets are intentionally empty. Supply them via environment variables or AWS Secrets Manager. Program.cs fails fast at startup if any are missing, rather than silently booting with a value committed to source control.

Dynamo.//TablePrefix: Prepended to every DynamoDB table name, so one AWS account can hold two environments. EMPTY IN DEV AND IT MUST STAY THAT WAY - the existing tables are unprefixed, and setting a prefix here would orphan every row already stored. Production sets Dynamo__TablePrefix=prod_ as a Lambda environment variable.
Dynamo.//AutoCreateTables: Reconciles the DynamoDB schema at startup: creates missing tables and adds indexes the code declares but the deployed table lacks. On by default because the alternative was a manual console step that gets forgotten, and a missing index fails silently as a table scan. Runs in the background, so it never delays a cold start. Needs ListTables/DescribeTable/CreateTable/UpdateTable on the execution role. Set false once the schema lives in real infrastructure code.
Dynamo.//UsePublishedIndex: Reads published listings from PublishedStatus-index instead of scanning Properties. MUST stay false until every published row has been re-saved so it appears in the sparse index - see docs/data-backfill-required.md. Switching this on early empties the homepage.

//Sentry: Dsn empty = monitoring off, app unaffected. Set it per environment (AWS Lambda env var Sentry__Dsn). Use a DIFFERENT Sentry project for each API.
//Verification: ShowTitleBadge governs whether a title-verified listing displays the 'Title Verified' badge to renters. Leave false until a lawyer has signed off on the wording - it is the strongest claim the platform makes and the first thing a defrauded buyer's lawyer will point at. Verification still runs and is recorded either way.
